critical_code_review_comments: blog_routes.py uses synchronous `requests` for object-storage I/O inside async FastAPI endpoints — blocks the event loop on every image upload/fetch. Acceptable for low traffic but should switch to httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool for high-traffic SEO image serving. Non-blocking for MVP.

Public image proxy /api/blogs/files/{id} loads entire payload into memory (StreamingResponse(io.BytesIO(data))). For larger images (≤6MB) acceptable, but a true streaming proxy (httpx stream + aiter_bytes) would be more efficient and avoid double-buffering.
_unique_slug loop has no upper bound — pathological many-collision case (e.g., 1000+ posts with same title) would run 1000+ DB queries. Add a hard cap (e.g., 50) and fall back to a UUID suffix.

AdminBlogs.jsx Field component places data-testid on the wrapper <div>, not the input — testing requires `[data-testid=admin-blog-title] input` chained selector. Consider also putting testid directly on inputs (e.g., admin-blog-title-input) for cleaner test selectors.
AdminBlogs.jsx is 686 lines (close to 700-line guideline). FeaturedImageInput, Field, SidePanel, BlogEditor could be split into /pages/admin/blog/ submodules for maintainability.

Frontend doesn't enforce client-side file size check before posting to /upload-image — a 7MB file uploads fully and only fails server-side with 413. Add `if (file.size > 6 * 1024 * 1024) toast.error(...)` in FeaturedImageInput + the body inline uploader.
blog_routes uses 200 for create instead of 201 (FastAPI default). Non-blocking but inconsistent with REST conventions used elsewhere if applicable.
